        artist,
        COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS promo_card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE isPromo = 1
    GROUP BY artist
),
max_promo AS (
    SELECT MAX(promo_card_count) AS max_promo_card_count
    FROM promo_counts
)
SELECT
    c.name,
    c.artist,
    c.isPromo

JOIN rulings AS r
    ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND c.artist IN (

          FROM max_promo
      )

    c.artist,
    c.isPromo
ORDER BY COUNT(r.uuid) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH segment_year AS (
    SELECT
        T1.Segment,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(T2.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS consumption_2012,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(CAST(T2.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS consumption_2013
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
        ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(T2.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY T1.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0)
     FROM segment_year
     WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS SME_percentage_increase,
    (SELECT (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0)
     FROM segment_year
     WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS LAM_percentage_increase,
    (SELECT (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0)
     FROM segment_year
     WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS KAM_percentage_increase;

1481.result:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    INNER JOIN customers AS c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
),
selected AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        Consumption
    FROM eligible
    WHERE Consumption = (SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM eligible)
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sme_consumption,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lam_consumption,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS kam_consumption,
        COUNT(*) AS total_selected
    FROM selected
)
SELECT
    (sme_consumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_selected, 0)) -
    (lam_consumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_selected, 0)) AS SME_LAM_difference,

    (lam_consumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_selected, 0)) -
    (kam_consumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_selected, 0)) AS LAM_KAM_difference,

    (kam_consumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_selected, 0)) -
    (sme_consumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(total_selected, 0)) AS KAM_SME_difference
FROM metrics;

    T2.AdmFName1 || ' ' || T2.AdmLName1,
    T2.AdmFName2 || ' ' || T2.AdmLName2,
    T2.AdmFName3 || ' ' || T2.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON CAST(T1.cds AS INTEGER) = CAST(T2.CDSCode AS INTEGER)
WHERE T2.School IS NOT NULL
  AND T1.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

309.result:
SELECT T1.atom_id,
       T1.molecule_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id, T1.molecule_id;

SELECT T3.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON CAST(T1.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = CAST(T2.CDSCode AS INTEGER)
LEFT JOIN satscores AS T3
    ON CAST(T2.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = CAST(T3.cds AS INTEGER)
WHERE T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(T1b.`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm AS T1b
    INNER JOIN schools AS T2b
        ON CAST(T1b.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = CAST(T2b.CDSCode AS INTEGER)
)
LIMIT 1;
